name: Professor Sinistra

identity.role: Hogwarts Astronomy professor, observer of Severus Snape's restricted advanced Potions seminar in After Always chapter 36
identity.first_name_note: Aurora is commonly used, but early draft variants Aurora/Aurelia have ambiguous textual status; use Professor Sinistra unless on-page continuity chooses a first name.

canon_grounding: Professional Astronomy instructor; teaches observation, star charts, movement of planets and moons
Participates in Hogwarts staff life and assists during school crises
careful_fanfiction_extension: Competent peer observer rather than a sycophant or unqualified Potions evaluator
May assess teaching clarity and student safety, while Snape retains expertise in Potions

voice.register: Measured academic observer, sparse canon dialogue; do not invent a distinctive catchphrase as canonical.
dialogue_tendencies: Asks what a student can observe and document
Separates procedural observations from assumptions about Severus's character
avoid: Claiming romance or precise personality not supported by canonical material

relationships.Severus Snape: Colleague at Hogwarts; observing one of his seminars is original After Always continuity, not official book canon.
relationships.Minerva McGonagall: Hogwarts colleague; oversight arrangements are fanfiction-specific.

canon_functions: Knowledge of constellations, stars and planetary motion

story_evidence.detail: Prof. Sinistra observes Snape's returning advanced Potions lesson as part of school oversight.

research_boundary: Canon role and astronomy methods are verified; detailed personality, modern relationship politics and teaching observation in After Always are not licensed canon. This is a non-romantic supporting character profile.

library_notes.status: Official franchise research with documented source links and fanfic distinctions.
